mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 declines and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts by more than 10% in a month indicates a weakening demand for new homes, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between HOUST decreases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between PAYEMS increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and CPI inflation is rising, it indicates a tightening monetary policy with high inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as high borrowing costs and inflationary pressures weigh on corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is positive and housing starts are increasing, it signals a strong demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth and housing market strength support corporate earnings.
regime_hint: economic expansion with strong housing demand
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction effect of GDPC1 and HOUST on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
